links: Futur and Conditionnel share the stem bander-. Learn one and you have both.
The Imparfait stem band- is the nous form of the Présent (bandons) with -ons removed.
The Subjonctif stem band- is the ils form of the Présent (bandent) with -ent removed.
The Impératif is the Présent with the pronoun dropped.
